iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now available for pre-order. Apple unveiled the new phones on Wednesday, featuring a variable aperture camera system, a smaller Dynamic Island, and four new color options.

  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro at Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max at Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro at Walmart
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max at Walmart

You can now pre-order the iPhone 18 Pro

Here's a quick look at some of the standout features of the iPhone 18 Pro lineup:

  • New variable aperture main camera for more precise control over lighting and depth of field.
  • New A20 Pro chip with 50% more memory bandwidth and 40% faster GPU performance.
  • A smaller Dynamic Island that can now show three Live Activities at once.
  • Major leap in battery life. The iPhone 18 Pro lasts up to 24 hours of daily use, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max extends that to 30 hours.
  • New vapor chamber thermal design for more sustained performance during longer use.
  • Faster wired charging: 50% in just 15 minutes.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max come in four colors:

  • Wine Red
  • Glacier Blue
  • Silver
  • Black

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Storage starts at 256GB and goes up to 2TB. Purchase options include paying in full, financing through Apple Card or a carrier, and the new Apple Upgrade rental plan.

The first batch of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders will arrive next Friday, September 18. The next round of pre-orders opens on October 16 for the iPhone Duo, with shipments beginning October 23.

Are you planning to pre-order the iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max, or are you still waiting for the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
